title: Birth of Isaac (Gen 21:1-3) beside the virgin's sign, Immanuel (Isa 7:14)
summary: Genesis 21:1-3 (Sarah bears Isaac at the appointed time) placed above Isaiah 7:14, where the Lord Himself gives a sign: the virgin shall conceive, bear a son and call his name Immanuel. Key words (Lord, sign, virgin, son, Immanuel) are shown in distinct colours.

text.text: 1 Then the LORD took note of Sarah as He had said,
and the LORD did for Sarah as He had promised.
2 So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham
in his old age, at the appointed time
of which God had spoken to him.
3 Abraham called the name of his son
who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
14 Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign;
Behold, the virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
and shall call his name Immanuel.

uncertain: Hebrew reference heading for Isaiah is spelled ישעה as on the slide.
